basic_info.description: Experience the perfect blend of sophistication, comfort, and connection in this light-filled urban retreat, gracefully set in a boutique elevator building in one of San Francisco's most desirable neighborhoods. This bright and spacious residence harmonizes classic charm with contemporary style where you won't miss a beat in the heart of Polk Gulch.    The airy, light-filled living room makes a striking first impression, featuring wide plank hardwood floors and a beautiful wood-burning fireplace, perfect for cozy nights or entertaining. The kitchen has been timelessly remodeled with classic white cabinetry, quartz countertops, designer tile backsplash, and stainless-steel appliances. The expansive bedroom is a serene sanctuary, bathed in natural light, with a sitting area ideal for enjoying your morning coffee. A large walk-in closet offers ample storage and space for a desk. Additional conveniences include in-unit laundry, dedicated storage, a peaceful garden courtyard, and independent one-car garage parking.    With a Walk Score of 99, you're steps from Michelin-starred restaurants, cozy pubs, curated boutiques, wine bars, pilates studios, and parks like Helen Wills and Lafayette Park.This is more than a home, it's your slice of San Francisco, where elegance and city charm meet
